newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian GDP down six pct in Jan-Nov.
newsitem.headline: Russian GDP down six pct in Jan-Nov.

text.p: Russian gross domestic product in the first 11 months of this year totalled 2,031 trillion roubles, which was six percent less than the same period in 1995 in inflation-adjusted terms, Russian news agencies quoted the State Statistics Committee as saying on Saturday.
GDP in November was two percent lower than in October and seven percent lower than a year earlier.
Note - Official Russian data tend to underreport a growing private sector in the economy.
